name: minerva
description: Cross-browser WebExtension that assists with online auctions by making effective prices transparent.

scripts.build: wxt build -b chrome && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.package: wxt zip -b chrome && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.typecheck: wxt prepare && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
